title: gastrodia javanica
intro: Gastrodia javanica, commonly known as Tiger's Eye or Chinese Swallowtail, is a type of orchid native to China and Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving blood circulation, thereby alleviating symptoms of conditions such as insomnia, anxiety, and neurological disorders. The therapeutic actions of Gastrodia javanica include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and anticonvulsant properties. The bioactive constituents of Gastrodia javanica include gastrodin, gastrodigenin, and other flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
